connector.name: Sms
connector.registryDescription: Real physical SIMs for AI agents: SMS verification and rentals. 145+ countries, 2500+ services.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.virtualsms.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package virtualsms-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the virtualsms-io account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
